We evaluate T2 across seven diverse CQA datasets ranging from simple factual queries to complex multi-hop reasoning tasks.

We evaluate our approach on seven QA datasets from diverse domains. SQuAD (general-domain questions from Wikipedia) , HotpotQA (multi-hop questions spanning multiple paragraphs) , BioASQ (biomedical queries requiring specialized knowledge) , NewsQA (news-related passages) , GAOKAO (exam-oriented dataset with academic coverage) , HQA (historical questions focusing on chronology and figures) , and TriviaQA (Wikipedia-based trivia) .
outputs: Generated answers and reasoning chains for contextual question answering tasks.

For automatic evaluation, we used GPT-4 to assess the structural accuracy, element boundary precision, and template usability of decompositions generated by each method on a scale of 1-5.
For human evaluation, we measured exact match, relaxed match, and structural correctness.
